recent_articles.title: Conference on higher education held - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Body donated for educational purposes cannot be returned: Kerala HC - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kerala High Court** ruled that a woman's body, donated to the **Government Medical College, Kalamassery**, cannot be returned based on her children's request. recent_articles.title: Submerged temple emerges as Bhavanisagar Dam level drops - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bhavanisagar Dam**'s water level dropping to 59 ft. has revealed the dilapidated **Sri Madhava Perumal Temple**, which was submerged during construction in the 1940s and 1950s.  A study of inscriptions on the temple premises found it to be located at the confluence of the Bhavani and Moyar rivers, once a significant trade route connecting Kongu with Karnataka and Kerala. The site is believed to have been ruled by the Hoysalas and served as the location for a fort built by **Madhava Perumal Dhandanayaka**, a general appointed by King Veera Ballala III.  The temple was last visible in 2024 when the water level dropped, and fishermen report that portions of the structure become visible again at lower water levels.

recent_articles.title: ASHAs meet Kerala CM-designate V.D. Satheesan, urge him to honour pre-poll promises - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala ASHA Health Workers’ Association (KAHWA)** met with **V.D. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC)** has issued a yellow alert for heavy rainfall in several districts of Tamil Nadu, including Villupuram, Mayiladuthurai, Cuddalore, and Theni on Saturday.  **D.S. recent_articles.title: Monsoon to reach Kerala on May 26, says IMD - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts the southwest monsoon will advance into Kerala on May 26, a day earlier than its usual June 1 arrival.  While this year's monsoon onset is anticipated to be early, there are concerns about below-normal rainfall. The IMD has historically been accurate in predicting the monsoon's arrival over Kerala, with only one exception in 2015. **M. Ravichandran**, Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, stated that after the monsoon onset, a period of heavy rain is expected for the next five days.  The IMD has warned of potential drought impacts due to reduced rainfall and the ongoing El Nino phenomenon.

recent_articles.title: What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 26-year-old Indian tourist, Kushagra Agarwal, died at a Phuket cafe after collapsing and three others fainted simultaneously. The incident occurred on May 9th and the **Indian embassy** is providing support to the deceased's family.  The four men were reportedly at a cafe around 11 pm before losing consciousness one by one. Two of the men remain in a coma, while the remaining three are reported as stable. Police are investigating but have not released any conclusions about the cause of the incident.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu’s political transition, growth story faultlines - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, led by C. Joseph Vijay, won the Tamil Nadu elections, raising questions about whether its victory signifies a departure from the Dravidian Model of development or simply an extension of it.  **TVK's** election manifesto suggests continuity with existing economic policies despite the challenges facing Tamil Nadu, including internal issues and external factors like shifts in federal relations and global economic changes. The state has historically demonstrated that inclusive economic growth can be achieved alongside social progress through investments in infrastructure, healthcare, and education.

recent_articles.title: Election results 2026: Why welfare policies aren't winning polls in India like it used to
recent_articles.rephrased_article: India's welfare politics, once a key electoral tool, is facing challenges. While cash transfers and subsidized services have become the norm across parties, recent state elections suggest that extensive welfare delivery alone is no longer enough to secure incumbency.  **Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress**, for example, lost power in West Bengal despite its women-centric welfare schemes. **The Bharatiya Janata Party** has capitalized on expanding welfare architecture, including women's self-help groups and administrative efficiency, while voters are increasingly demanding more than just welfare benefits.  Political scientists argue that this shift signifies a move from the floor of Indian politics to the ceiling, where parties must build coalitions around broader issues like job creation and economic mobility.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls 2026: IUML growing restive over Congress delaying CM decision - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian Union Muslim League (IUML)**, a key force in the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**'s victory in the April 9 Assembly election, is facing discontent over the delay in finalizing the Chief Minister.  **IUML** leaders have expressed concern about the perceived casual attitude of some **Congress** leaders, particularly **Mathew Kuzhalnadan** and **M.M. Hassan**, who they believe are overlooking the party's contribution to the UDF's success. The IUML leadership is calling for a resolution to the uncertainty by Wednesday at a meeting with **State president Syed Sadikali Shihab Thangal**.  The prolonged delay has led to public disappointment and concerns about the spirit of the people's mandate.
